events.what: Zero-density exponent for Dirichlet L-functions improved from 12/5 to 7/3 by extending the Guth–Maynard large-value method
Under RH, an equivalence between a distributional property of zeta zeros and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions
Self-published ResearchGate claims of an AI/ChatGPT-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis
events.credibility_reason: F5: landmark problem with no expert uptake, never posted to arXiv, author has a history of repeated RH proof postings, and the record could not open the text (403); concerns RH rather than being shown to address GRH.
events.ai_basis: Title: 'A Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis Assisted by Artificial Intelligence' (not opened)

judgement.doubts: The author list of arXiv:2507.08296 was inconsistent across the researcher's fetches ('Bin Chen' alone vs. 'Bin Chen, Vishal Gupta, Yung Chi Li'); credited_humans is kept as the abstract-page reading but may be incomplete. A zero-density exponent is a quantity bounded on an open question, so progress is right under §4; the competing 'open' reading is rejected.

corrections.why: other: kept, but the record's dead_ends note that some fetches of arXiv:2507.08296 listed 'Bin Chen, Vishal Gupta, Yung Chi Li'; the author list is not confirmed.
